mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate, as a proxy for monetary policy tightness, compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a robust labor market that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a rising consumer price index signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth is above 2.5% and UNRATE is below 4.0%, a month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL of more than 0.2% does not produce significantly negative 60-day returns (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production, as a proxy for economic output, indicates strong corporate activity and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1,300,000 units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1,300,000 units, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both increase, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes, a rising consumer price index signals inflationary pressures from supply shocks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO growth is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% year-over-year, a month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL of more than 0.2% does not produce significantly negative 5-day returns (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.
